signIn.title: Operator sign-in
signIn.subtitle: For the platform's own staff. Tenants sign in at their own address.

onboard.title: Onboard a tenant
onboard.text: Creates the tenant's database, enables its plan's applications and invites its first administrator.
onboard.slugHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It becomes the tenant's web address.
onboard.doneText: Send this one-time link to the first administrator: {{url}}
onboard.doneResumed: Onboarding finished. The first administrator was already invited.

tenant.planText: Applications that the new plan doesn't include are removed at once.
tenant.modulesHint: The plan's applications are always on. Others can be added on top.
tenant.supportApproval: Support access needs the tenant's approval
tenant.supportHint: Time-limited, audited access to one application. If the tenant requires approval, its admin must approve it first.

lifecycle.suspendText: The tenant becomes read-only until you resume it.
lifecycle.offboardText: Everyone is signed out and the tenant's data is exported. It is deleted after the grace period unless you cancel.
lifecycle.completeText: The tenant's database is dropped. This can't be undone.
